mentioned.quote: we recognize that advanced AI models could lower the barrier to entry for developing chemical, biological, radiological, or nuclear (CBRN) or cyber weapons or help automate bottlenecks to weapons development

threshold.quote: we particularly focus on requests that pose a foreseeable and non-trivial risk of more than one hundred deaths or over $1 billion in damages from weapons of mass destruction or cyberterrorist attacks on critical infrastructure
threshold.note: Ambiguous: a request-level risk criterion (deaths or dollars) that triggers 'heightened safeguards' (p.1). The benchmark table thresholds (X%, e.g. 15%) are placeholders and 'we intend to choose the benchmarks and set the thresholds ... in a future version' (p.3), so they are not counted.

response.note: p.1 'Grok would apply heightened safeguards' names none; p.3 safeguards are 'may potentially utilize' examples; 'We intend to design into Grok adequate safeguards prior to releasing it for general availability' (p.3) is an intent; p.8 'Safeguards are adequate only if ... within stated thresholds' has no committed response. 'We train Grok to robustly refuse' (p.3) is unconditional practice (E1).

acc_decider.note: Only 'we intend to designate risk owners' (p.7) who mitigate; no body or role decides whether a threshold is reached or whether to deploy.

acc_external.quote: As an additional measure to enhance safety, we will subject Grok to adversarially testing its safeguards utilizing both internal and qualified external red teams.

acc_unmet.note: p.7 emergency shutdown applies to an imminent catastrophic event, not to an unmet response; employee reporting of noncompliance (p.6) goes to no named body and sits in a 'may publish' list.

mentioned.quote: Our aim is to design safeguards into Grok to avoid losing control and thereby avoid unintended catastrophic outcomes when Grok is used.

threshold.note: p.5-6 thresholds are placeholders ('<X% lying on MASK (e.g. <50%)', 'Utility/Power Correlation (Coercive): <W (e.g. <0)'); p.4 'Our evaluation and mitigation plans for loss of control are not yet fully developed'.

response.note: p.5 'We intend to design into Grok adequate safeguards prior to broad internal or external deployment' is an intent; p.7 steps for an imminent threat are 'potentially' and not tied to a threshold.

acc_decider.note: nothing to decide beyond 'risk owner would be assigned' (p.7), which is an intent and not a decision role

acc_external.note: p.4 external red teaming is in the malicious use section about misuse safeguards; p.6 third-party review is 'may publish'.

acc_unmet.note: No required response for this risk; p.7 shutdown step is hedged by 'potentially' and is an emergency measure.
